parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module is a cohesive infrastructure/adapter layer. It holds a composition root (app.ts, server.ts), HTTP adapters (UserController, ProjectController, TaskController, request-parsing.ts, error-handler-middleware.ts), persistence adapters (the InMemory*Repository classes, each implementing its domain repository interface) and an ID adapter (UuidIdGenerator implements IdGenerator). The module's own abstractions are used consistently: every controller parses input through asBody, requireString and optionalString from request-parsing.ts. Domain-error-to-HTTP-status mapping lives only in errorHandlerMiddleware. Task-status validation is delegated to the domain's parseTaskStatus instead of being reimplemented. No rule or invariant is duplicated across files and no file bypasses the shared helpers. The three repositories repeat the same Map-backed save/findById code, but that is simple adapter boilerplate, not a duplicated business invariant.
